title: Symphonic Awakening
description: The first steps into orchestral composition and film scoring: a symphonic awakening built around strings, brass and cinematic textures.
story: Symphonic Awakening represents the beginning of a creative journey into orchestral composition and film scoring. Built around strings, brass and cinematic textures, it marks the first chapter of Expedition Creativity: learning how orchestral colours can carry emotion, discovery and storytelling.
